Every entry stores fully expanded argv (no shell strings), a timeout, the minimum non-zero test count and the task that registered it. A runner exiting 0 after executing 0 cases is NOT a pass: check.mjs enforces minCases. Modules land here in the same task that introduces their suite — never batched into Phase 10. Reconstructed 2026-09-21 after an unsafe restore truncated this file to 0 bytes; every case below was re-run to confirm it matches the behaviour measured before the loss.

unknown module, missing suite, skipped required case and zero executed cases all fail
a case may be opt-in (optInEnv + a mandatory optInReason); opt-in skips are printed per line, reported in the summary and never counted as passed
